acceptance_criteria: Traces to its accepted system anchor and is verified by its named checks.
statement: No verification command **shall** open a TCP listener, create an `AF_INET`/`AF_INET6` socket, use DNS, a resolver, or TLS, contact an external network peer, execute a legacy binary or production workload, or make a runtime, compatibility, performance, or production-readiness claim beyond the executed checks.
title: Offline and no-legacy execution
